items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: they had the Pee Wee Russell fan club and Sidney Bechet fan club

ctx.x: But he wasn’t . . . you kind of knew what he wanted to play when you hear him playing it and he had a certain degree of musicality that was valid, but they had the Pee Wee Russell fan club and Sidney Bechet fan club and there was one critic who every time I made a record he would Bum wrap it. He would put it down and write about how
terrible I was and what a terrible clarinetist I was. He had a group of people come in specifically to boo me off the stage. I learned that later on.
